skills.name: elmos-billing-orchestrator
skills.title: Elmos Billing Orchestrator
skills.description: Orchestrate repository-wide implementation of Elmos hybrid billing: subscriptions, prepaid execution credits, capped or fixed-price projects, enterprise contracts, BYOK, metering, ledger, invoicing, controls, and evidence. Use for planning, sequencing, auditing, or completing the full billing program; do not use for a single isolated endpoint when a narrower billing skill applies.

skills.name: elmos-pricing-product-model
skills.title: Pricing Product Model
skills.description: Define and implement Elmos's hybrid monetization product model: subscription plus prepaid execution credits, pay-as-used tasks, capped/fixed-price projects, and enterprise annual contracts. Use when creating pricing concepts, customer segments, commercial rules, price-book versioning, or monetization decisions; not for ledger posting or payment-provider integration.

skills.name: elmos-plan-catalog-entitlements
skills.title: Plan Catalog and Entitlements
skills.description: Implement plan catalog, subscriptions, seats, included credits, feature entitlements, concurrency limits, retention, and tenant-level overrides for Elmos. Use when adding Free/Pro/Builder/Team/Enterprise capabilities or enforcing plan access; not for usage cost calculation or invoice payment settlement.

skills.name: elmos-credit-wallet-ledger
skills.title: Credit Wallet and Double-Entry Ledger
skills.description: Build Elmos prepaid execution-credit wallets and an append-only double-entry ledger with holds, capture, release, expiry, promotional versus paid balances, idempotency, and reconciliation. Use for any balance mutation, reservation, settlement, credit grant, adjustment, or ledger audit; never update balances directly.

skills.name: elmos-usage-metering
skills.title: Usage Metering and Cost Events
skills.description: Implement immutable, idempotent usage metering for model tokens, cache, sandbox CPU/GPU time, browser automation, tests, storage, network, and third-party tools. Use when ingesting, normalizing, rating, aggregating, or reconciling task resource consumption; not for choosing customer-facing project prices.

skills.name: elmos-task-cost-estimation
skills.title: Task Cost and Runtime Estimation
skills.description: Estimate Elmos task cost, resource mix, autonomous machine wall-clock runtime, confidence intervals, and human-effort comparison from repository and task features. Use before task execution, for quote generation, model-mode comparison, or estimator calibration; not for final ledger settlement.

skills.name: elmos-quote-budget-guard
skills.title: Quote and Budget Guard
skills.description: Create task quote cards, authorize credit holds, enforce soft/hard budget thresholds, pause before overspend, support top-ups and low-cost replanning, and settle actual usage. Use for pre-run quotations and in-run cost controls; not for defining the base price book itself.

skills.name: elmos-project-pricing-contracts
skills.title: Capped and Fixed-Price Project Contracts
skills.description: Implement discovery quotes, capped-price and fixed-price project contracts, scope freeze, milestones, acceptance criteria, included revisions, change orders, risk reserves, and project settlement. Use for repository conversions, modernization, full-project generation, migrations, or standardized project SKUs; not for open-ended exploratory tasks.

skills.name: elmos-subscription-invoicing
skills.title: Subscriptions and Invoicing
skills.description: Implement billing periods, subscription charges, included-credit grants, proration, invoice lines, taxes, credit notes, renewal, dunning handoff, and immutable invoice snapshots. Use for recurring plan billing and invoice generation; not for payment gateway callbacks or task usage capture.

skills.name: elmos-payments-reconciliation
skills.title: Payments and Reconciliation
skills.description: Integrate payment-provider-agnostic intents, webhooks, authorization/capture, top-ups, refunds handoff, settlement files, and three-way reconciliation between provider, invoice, and ledger. Use for payment processing and cash reconciliation; not for defining vendor-specific secrets in source code.

skills.name: elmos-refunds-disputes
skills.title: Refunds, Adjustments, and Disputes
skills.description: Implement policy-driven refunds, partial refunds, credits, chargebacks, disputes, platform-fault compensation, user-fault settlement, manual adjustments, approvals, and evidence. Use when reversing charges or resolving failed-task billing complaints; not for silently deleting usage or ledger history.

skills.name: elmos-enterprise-byok
skills.title: Enterprise Contracts and BYOK
skills.description: Implement enterprise annual contracts, committed spend, postpaid credit limits, private deployment charges, SLA, tenant overrides, cost centers, purchase orders, and BYOK split billing. Use for enterprise pricing, private model gateways, customer-owned API keys, or invoiced accounts; not for storing raw provider keys in the billing database.

skills.name: elmos-cost-margin-analytics
skills.title: Cost Allocation and Margin Analytics
skills.description: Build transaction-grounded cost allocation, revenue, gross margin, quote accuracy, unit economics, cohort, provider, model, tenant, task, and project analytics. Use for pricing decisions, profitability, cost optimization, or finance reporting; not as the authoritative source for wallet balances or invoices.

skills.name: elmos-billing-admin-ux
skills.title: Billing Customer and Admin UX
skills.description: Implement customer quote cards, wallet, invoices, usage detail, project contracts, budget controls, team cost centers, and admin operations with clear explanations and audit-safe actions. Use for billing UI/API journeys and operator consoles; not for embedding financial rules only in the frontend.

skills.name: elmos-security-compliance
skills.title: Billing Security and Compliance
skills.description: Apply tenant isolation, RBAC/ABAC, separation of duties, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, anti-fraud, webhook security, privacy, retention, export, deletion, and financial-control evidence to Elmos billing. Use for threat modeling, control implementation, compliance gates, or red-team review.

skills.name: elmos-billing-observability-ops
skills.title: Billing Observability and Operations
skills.description: Implement metrics, logs, traces, SLOs, alerts, runbooks, replay, reconciliation operations, disaster recovery, and incident controls for Elmos billing. Use for production readiness, anomaly response, stuck settlement, missing usage, budget drift, or financial incidents; not for masking invariant violations with retries.

skills.name: elmos-billing-testing-certification
skills.title: Billing Testing and Production Certification
skills.description: Design and run unit, property, contract, integration, concurrency, chaos, security, financial reconciliation, migration, and end-to-end tests for Elmos billing. Use to verify implementation claims, certify releases, or audit regressions; not for accepting mocked success as production evidence.

skills.name: elmos-rollout-migration
skills.title: Billing Rollout and Migration
skills.description: Plan and execute safe migration from legacy or no billing to Elmos hybrid billing using data cleanup, opening balances, dual write, shadow rating, canaries, tenant waves, reconciliation, rollback, and support readiness. Use for production rollout, price migration, wallet import, or cutover; not for big-bang irreversible launch.
